afforded.en: gave someone a chance or time
afforded.ex: The delay afforded us time to prepare.

ahead.ex: The concert will go ahead despite the rain.

alerted.ex: A neighbour alerted the police to the smoke.

allowed.ex: Dogs are not allowed in the shop.

also.ex: She speaks French and also some German.

alternatives.en: other things you can use instead
alternatives.ex: There are healthy alternatives to sugar.

ample.ex: There is ample parking behind the hotel.

appeal.en: asking a higher court to change a decision
appeal.ex: The singer won his appeal against the fine.

applicant.en: the person or company bringing a case
applicant.ex: Each applicant must send two references.

approval.ex: The plan needs approval from the council.

are.ex: The shops are open until eight.

argued.en: gave reasons to support an opinion
argued.ex: She argued that the price was too high.

arguments.en: reasons given to support a view
arguments.ex: The judge listened to both arguments.

assertion.en: a firm statement that something is true
assertion.ex: There is no evidence for his assertion.

example.en: There is little evidence for his assertion.
example.zh: 他的主張幾乎沒有證據支持。

note.usage: 常見 make an assertion、support/challenge an assertion；動詞為 assert。

noteEn.meaning: a strong statement that something is true.

noteEs.exampleTr: Hay pocas pruebas de su afirmación.

noteHi.exampleTr: उसके दावे के पक्ष में बहुत कम सबूत है।
noteHi.meaning: दावा; ज़ोर देकर कही गई बात।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼の主張を裏付ける証拠はほとんどない。
noteJa.usage: support/challenge an assertion の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그의 주장을 뒷받침할 증거는 거의 없다.

assessment.ex: The safety assessment took six months.

authorisation.ex: You need authorisation to enter this area.

example.en: You need written authorisation to enter the lab.
example.zh: 進入實驗室需要書面授權。

note.usage: 英式拼法（美式 authorization）；常見 renew/grant/withdraw authorisation。

noteEn.meaning: official permission to do or sell something.

noteEs.exampleTr: Necesitas autorización por escrito para entrar al laboratorio.

noteHi.exampleTr: प्रयोगशाला में जाने के लिए लिखित अनुमति चाहिए।

noteJa.exampleTr: 研究室に入るには書面による許可が必要だ。

back.en: to the place or state before
back.ex: Please bring the book back on Monday.

backed.ex: Most voters backed the new law.

bacon.ex: He had bacon and eggs for breakfast.

ban.en: an official rule that stops something
ban.ex: The city introduced a ban on plastic bags.

based.ex: The firm is based in Galway.

be.ex: The shop will be closed tomorrow.

bid.en: an attempt to get or do something
bid.ex: The town made a bid to host the festival.

big.ex: They live in a big house near the sea.

borne.ex: Her fears were borne out by the results.

brought.ex: The case was brought by local residents.

brussels.en: city used to mean the EU's leaders

burden.ex: The burden is on the seller to explain the fault.
burden.zh: 舉證責任（burden of proof）；負擔

carefully.ex: Read the contract carefully before you sign.

case.ex: The court will hear the case in May.

cautioned.ex: Doctors cautioned against eating too much salt.

challenge.en: a legal attempt to change a decision
challenge.ex: The group launched a challenge to the new rule.

characteristic.ex: The town has a characteristic blue harbour.

cheese.ex: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.

citing.ex: The shop closed, citing high costs.

claim.en: a statement that something is true
claim.ex: There was no proof for his claim.

commission.en: the European Commission, the EU's executive

companies.ex: Many companies now let staff work from home.

company.ex: She works for a software company.

concluded.ex: The report concluded that the bridge was safe.

confirmed.ex: The test confirmed that the water was safe.

consequently.ex: It rained all day; consequently, the match was cancelled.

considering.ex: She is considering a move to Cork.

contended.ex: Critics contended that the plan was too costly.

conventional.ex: Many farmers still prefer conventional methods.

could.ex: She could see the sea from her room.

countries.ex: Many countries signed the new climate deal.

court.en: place where legal cases are decided
court.ex: The case went to court last spring.

crisps.en: thin fried potato slices in a bag
crisps.ex: He bought a bag of salty crisps.

declined.ex: He declined to comment on the rumour.

demonstrate.en: to show clearly that something is true
demonstrate.ex: The data demonstrate a clear link.

dependent.en: needing something in order to work
dependent.ex: The town is dependent on tourism.

did.ex: He did his homework before dinner.

disappointed.en: sad because something was not as hoped
disappointed.ex: Fans were disappointed by the result.

disappointment.ex: She hid her disappointment with a smile.

discontinue.en: to stop doing or using something
discontinue.ex: The company will discontinue the old model.

example.en: The company will discontinue the old model next year.
example.zh: 公司明年將停產舊款型號。

note.meaning: 停止；中止（使用、生產或服務）。
note.usage: 正式用語，及物動詞，常見 discontinue a product/service/use。

noteEn.meaning: to stop using, making or offering something.

noteEs.exampleTr: La empresa dejará de fabricar el modelo antiguo el próximo año.
noteEs.meaning: suspender; dejar de usar o producir.

noteHi.exampleTr: कंपनी अगले साल पुराना मॉडल बंद कर देगी।
noteHi.meaning: बंद करना; उपयोग या उत्पादन रोकना।

noteJa.exampleTr: その会社は来年旧モデルの製造を中止する。
noteJa.usage: discontinue a product/service の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 회사는 내년에 구형 모델을 단종할 것이다.

dismissed.en: officially rejected a case or claim

dispense.ex: We can dispense with the formal speeches.

distinctive.ex: The bird has a distinctive red tail.

drive.en: to force someone into a situation
drive.ex: High rents drive families out of the city.

earlier.ex: She had called earlier that day.

effects.en: results or changes caused by something
effects.ex: The drug has few side effects.

either.en: used before the first of two choices

emphasised.en: said firmly that something is important
emphasised.ex: The teacher emphasised the need for practice.

enable.en: to make it possible for someone to do something
enable.ex: The grant will enable her to study abroad.

encourage.en: to make something more likely to happen
encourage.ex: Low prices encourage people to buy more.

endorsed.ex: The board endorsed the new strategy.

example.en: Most members endorsed the new safety rules.
example.zh: 大多數成員支持新的安全規定。

note.usage: 及物動詞，常見 endorse a decision/plan/candidate；名詞 endorsement。

noteEn.meaning: to say officially that you support something.

noteEs.exampleTr: La mayoría de los miembros respaldó las nuevas normas de seguridad.

noteHi.exampleTr: अधिकांश सदस्यों ने नए सुरक्षा नियमों का समर्थन किया।

noteJa.exampleTr: 大半のメンバーが新しい安全規則を承認した。
noteJa.usage: endorse a decision/plan の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 대부분의 회원이 새 안전 규정을 승인했다.

evaluation.en: a careful study of value or risk
evaluation.ex: The evaluation found the scheme worked well.

evidence.en: facts that show something is true
evidence.ex: There is no evidence that the plan failed.

examine.ex: Experts will examine the new data.

expressed.ex: Parents expressed concern about the plan.

extended.ex: They took an extended holiday in Spain.

failed.en: did not succeed in doing something
failed.ex: He failed to answer the last question.

fears.en: worries that something bad may happen
fears.ex: Fears of a strike grew last week.

fight.en: to try hard to stop something
fight.ex: The town will fight the plan in court.

find.ex: We need to find a new supplier.

finding.ex: The judge ruled for her, finding the contract unfair.

fish.en: animals from water eaten as food
fish.ex: We had fish and rice for dinner.

flavour.ex: This soup has a strong garlic flavour.

flavourings.en: substances added to food to give taste
flavourings.zh: 調味料（smoke flavourings：煙燻調味料）

food.ex: The food at the market was fresh.

foods.ex: Some foods are high in salt.

for.en: used to show purpose or time

found.ex: The survey found most people liked the park.

from.en: showing where something starts or comes

gave.ex: The extra week gave us time to prepare.

general.en: part of the name EU General Court
general.zh: General（EU General Court：歐盟普通法院）

giant.en: a very large and powerful company
giant.ex: The tech giant opened a new office.

give.ex: Herbs give the soup a fresh taste.

go.ex: The concert will go ahead despite the rain.
go.zh: 去（go ahead：繼續進行；go back：回到）

government.en: the group of people who rule a country
government.ex: The Government will publish its plan soon.

gradual.ex: There has been a gradual rise in prices.

greater.ex: Cars cause greater pollution than bikes.

grounds.ex: She left the job on health grounds.
grounds.zh: 理由（on health grounds：基於健康理由）

group.en: a set of companies owned together
group.ex: The hotel belongs to a large travel group.

ham.en: salted or smoked meat from a pig
ham.ex: He made a ham and cheese sandwich.

harmless.ex: Most spiders in Ireland are harmless.

has.en: owns; also used to form past tenses

have.en: own; also used to form past tenses
have.ex: We have enough time to finish.

health.ex: Walking every day is good for your health.

healthier.ex: Fruit is a healthier snack than chocolate.

hinged.ex: Everything hinged on the final vote.

identify.ex: Can you identify the bird in this photo?

in.en: inside; at a place or time

indicated.ex: The report indicated a rise in prices.

industry.en: all the companies in one area of business
industry.ex: The food industry employs many people.

informed.ex: The school informed parents about the change.

ingredients.ex: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl.

judgment.ex: The judge will give her judgment tomorrow.

lawful.ex: Is it lawful to fly a drone here?

legal.ex: She took legal action against the company.

lend.ex: Lemon can lend a fresh taste to fish.

lies.ex: The decision lies with the manager.
lies.zh: 在於（the burden lies with：責任在於）

lodge.en: officially make a complaint or appeal
lodge.ex: He plans to lodge a complaint.
lodge.zh: 提出（lodge an appeal：提出上訴）

maintained.en: said firmly that something is true
maintained.ex: He maintained that he had done nothing wrong.

makers.en: people or companies that produce things
makers.ex: Car makers are building more electric cars.

meat.ex: I don't eat meat on Fridays.

member.ex: Every member of the team helped.

method.ex: This cooking method keeps the food healthy.

mid.ex: The shop will open in mid-May.

might.ex: We might go to the beach tomorrow.

move.en: an action taken to achieve something
move.ex: The move to raise taxes was unpopular.

much.en: a lot; to a large degree
much.ex: This bag is much heavier than mine.
much.zh: 多（as much as：多達；much more：更加）

nevertheless.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.

noted.ex: The report noted a rise in costs.

now.ex: I am busy now, call me later.

number.ex: A number of students were late today.

observed.ex: The judge observed that the rules were clear.

old.ex: The old system was very slow.

older.ex: The older machines use more power.

on.en: at a time or day; about

once.en: at some time in the past
once.ex: This building was once a school.

onus.en: the duty or responsibility to do something
onus.ex: The onus is on parents to keep children safe.

example.en: The onus is on the seller to describe the car honestly.
example.zh: 賣方有責任誠實描述車況。

note.usage: 正式用語，常見 the onus is on sb to do sth / the onus rests with sb。

noteEn.meaning: the duty or responsibility to do something.
noteEn.usage: Say 'the onus is on someone to...'.

noteEs.exampleTr: La responsabilidad de describir el coche con honestidad recae en el vendedor.
noteEs.usage: Se usa the onus is on alguien to do algo.

noteHi.exampleTr: कार का ईमानदारी से वर्णन करना विक्रेता की ज़िम्मेदारी है।
noteHi.usage: the onus is on sb to do sth आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 車を正直に説明する責任は売り手にある。
noteJa.usage: the onus is on 人 to do の形で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 차를 정직하게 설명할 책임은 판매자에게 있다.
noteKo.usage: the onus is on 사람 to do 형태로 쓴다.

onus.zh: 責任；舉證義務（the onus rests on：責任在於）

opted.ex: Many students opted to study online this year.

option.ex: Cycling is a cheap option for getting to work.

out.en: used in phrases meaning away, ended or removed
out.ex: The milk ran out before breakfast.
out.zh: （片語用）出；完；盡（out of the question：不可能；year is out：年底前）

overturn.en: to change an official decision to the opposite
overturn.ex: The judge refused to overturn the earlier ruling.

period.ex: There is a two-week trial period for new staff.

permissible.ex: Is it permissible to park here on Sundays?

phase.en: phase out: to stop using something slowly
phase.ex: The city will phase out diesel buses by 2030.

phase-out.en: the slow ending of the use of something
phase-out.ex: The phase-out of coal will take ten years.

phasing.en: phasing out: slowly stopping the use of something
phasing.ex: The phasing out of plastic bags has been popular.
phasing.ja: 段階的に廃止すること

plan.en: an idea of what you will do
plan.ex: The town has a plan to build more homes.

pose.en: to cause a risk or problem
pose.ex: Old bridges may pose a danger to drivers.

poses.ex: Smoking poses a serious threat to health.

potentially.ex: The storm could potentially close the airport.
potentially.ja: 潜在的に；もしかすると

previously.ex: She previously worked as a teacher in Cork.

producers.en: companies that make food or goods

product.ex: This product is sold in every Irish shop.

products.ex: The shop sells local dairy products.

prohibition.en: an official rule that stops something
prohibition.ex: The prohibition on smoking in pubs began in 2004.

example.en: There is a prohibition on smoking in all restaurants.

note.usage: 可數名詞，常見 a prohibition on/against + 名詞。

noteEn.meaning: a rule that says something is not allowed.

noteEs.exampleTr: Hay una prohibición de fumar en todos los restaurantes.
noteEs.usage: Se usa a prohibition on + sustantivo.

noteHi.exampleTr: सभी रेस्तराँ में धूम्रपान पर प्रतिबंध है।
noteHi.usage: a prohibition on + संज्ञा आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: すべてのレストランで喫煙は禁止されている。
noteJa.usage: a prohibition on + 名詞 の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: a prohibition on + 명사 형태가 흔하다.

proof.en: facts that show something is true
proof.ex: You need proof of address to open an account.
proof.zh: 證據（burden of proof：舉證責任）

proportion.en: a part or share of a whole
proportion.ex: A large proportion of students live at home.
proportion.zh: 比例；部分（in proportion to：按……比例）

protracted.ex: After protracted talks, the two sides agreed.

example.en: After protracted talks, the two sides reached a deal.
example.zh: 經過冗長的談判，雙方達成協議。

note.meaning: 拖延的；持續時間比預期更長的。

noteEs.exampleTr: Tras unas negociaciones prolongadas, ambas partes llegaron a un acuerdo.
noteEs.meaning: prolongado; que dura más de lo esperado.

noteHi.exampleTr: लंबी बातचीत के बाद दोनों पक्ष समझौते पर पहुँचे।
noteHi.meaning: लंबा खिंचा हुआ; अपेक्षा से अधिक समय तक चलने वाला।

noteJa.exampleTr: 長引いた協議の末、双方は合意に達した。

noteKo.exampleTr: 길게 이어진 협상 끝에 양측은 합의에 이르렀다.

prove.en: to show that something is true
prove.ex: Can you prove that you paid the bill?

proved.ex: The test proved that the water was safe.

provided.ex: The school provided free lunches for all pupils.

public.en: for or about all people in a country
public.ex: Public health is the top priority.

purified.en: made clean by removing harmful things
purified.ex: Purified water is used in the hospital.

push.en: to force or move someone towards something
push.ex: High rents push young people out of cities.

rashers.ex: We had rashers and eggs for breakfast.

rejected.ex: The council rejected the plan for a new road.

relied.en: needed something in order to work
relied.ex: The farm relied on rain for its crops.

remains.ex: The museum remains open during the works.

renew.en: to make something valid for longer
renew.ex: You must renew your passport every ten years.

reportedly.ex: The singer is reportedly planning a new tour.
reportedly.ja: 伝えられるところでは

required.en: made to do something by rules
required.ex: Drivers are required to wear seat belts.

rests.en: belongs to or depends on someone
rests.ex: The decision rests with the head teacher.
rests.zh: 在於（the onus rests on：責任在於）

return.ex: Many shops will return to normal hours next week.

revert.en: to go back to an earlier way
revert.ex: After the holidays, we revert to normal hours.

example.en: After the trial, prices reverted to their usual level.
example.zh: 試辦期結束後，價格恢復到平常水準。

note.meaning: 恢復；回到（原來的狀態或做法）。
note.usage: 不及物動詞，固定搭配 revert to + 名詞；不說 revert back。

noteEn.meaning: to go back to an earlier way or state.

noteEs.exampleTr: Tras la prueba, los precios volvieron a su nivel habitual.
noteEs.meaning: volver; regresar a un estado anterior.

noteHi.exampleTr: परीक्षण के बाद कीमतें सामान्य स्तर पर लौट आईं।
noteHi.meaning: वापस लौटना; पुरानी स्थिति में जाना।
noteHi.usage: revert to + संज्ञा; revert back न कहें।

noteJa.exampleTr: 試行期間の後、価格は通常の水準に戻った。
noteJa.usage: revert to + 名詞 の形で使う。revert back とは言わない。

noteKo.exampleTr: 시범 기간 후 가격이 평소 수준으로 돌아갔다.
noteKo.usage: revert to + 명사 형태로 쓰며 revert back은 쓰지 않는다.

review.en: a careful look to check something
review.ex: The safety review found no major problems.

risk.en: the chance that something bad happens
risk.ex: There is a small risk of side effects.

riskier.ex: Driving at night is riskier in winter.

risks.ex: Doctors explained the risks of the surgery.

ruled.en: ruled out: said to be impossible
ruled.ex: Police have ruled out foul play.

ruling.ex: The judge is ruling on the case next week.

safe.ex: Is this beach safe for swimming?

safer.ex: Trains are safer than cars for long trips.

safety.ex: Food safety rules are strict in the EU.

said.ex: She said the shop would open at nine.

says.ex: The report says prices will rise.

scientific.ex: There is strong scientific evidence for this idea.

scientists.ex: Scientists studied the river for five years.

scope.en: the chance or room to do something
scope.ex: There is scope for more cycle lanes in the city.
scope.zh: 餘地；空間（ample scope：充分空間）

scrutinise.en: to look at something very carefully
scrutinise.ex: Lawyers will scrutinise every page of the contract.

sector.en: one part of the economy or business
sector.ex: The tech sector employs thousands in Dublin.

several.en: more than two but not many

shelves.en: flat boards in shops that hold goods
shelves.ex: The shelves were empty after the storm.

show.ex: The tests show that the water is clean.

shown.ex: The study has shown a clear link.

smoke.en: the grey cloud made when something burns
smoke.ex: Thick smoke rose from the chimney.

smoking.en: preserving food by hanging it in smoke
smoking.ex: Smoking fish is an old way to keep it longer.

smoky.ex: This cheese has a rich smoky taste.

sold.en: given to someone in exchange for money
sold.ex: All the tickets were sold in one hour.

some.en: a number of, but not all

source.en: to find and get something you need
source.ex: The café sources its milk from local farms.

states.ex: All member states must agree on the new budget.

still.ex: The old castle is still standing.

stop.ex: Please stop talking during the film.

stressed.ex: The doctor stressed the need for rest.

studying.en: looking at something carefully to understand it
studying.ex: Lawyers are studying the new contract.

subsequently.ex: He moved to Cork and subsequently opened a café.

substances.ex: Some substances in food can harm health.

substantial.ex: The school received a substantial grant from the council.

example.en: A substantial number of students work part-time.
example.zh: 相當多的學生兼職打工。

note.usage: 學術寫作常用以取代 big/large，如 a substantial proportion/amount。

noteEs.exampleTr: Un número considerable de estudiantes trabaja a tiempo parcial.

noteHi.exampleTr: बड़ी संख्या में छात्र अंशकालिक काम करते हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: かなりの数の学生がアルバイトをしている。
noteJa.usage: a substantial proportion/amount の形で big の代わりに使う。

noteKo.usage: a substantial proportion/amount 형태로 big 대신 쓴다.

substantiate.ex: She could not substantiate her claims with evidence.

example.en: He could not substantiate his claim with any data.
example.zh: 他無法用任何數據證實自己的說法。

note.meaning: 證實；提出證據支持（說法）。

noteEn.meaning: to prove something is true with evidence.

noteEs.exampleTr: No pudo fundamentar su afirmación con ningún dato.

noteHi.exampleTr: वह किसी डेटा से अपने दावे को प्रमाणित नहीं कर सका।
noteHi.usage: substantiate a claim आम प्रयोग है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼はどのデータでも自分の主張を立証できなかった。
noteJa.usage: substantiate a claim の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그는 어떤 데이터로도 자신의 주장을 입증하지 못했다.

substitutes.en: things used instead of other things
substitutes.ex: Many people use plant milk as substitutes for dairy.

sufficient.ex: There is sufficient food for everyone.

support.en: to help show that something is true
support.ex: The data support the doctor's view.

supported.ex: Most parents supported the new school rules.

tang.en: a strong, sharp taste or smell
tang.ex: The sauce has a nice tang of lemon.

taste.en: the flavour of food in your mouth
taste.ex: I love the taste of fresh bread.

technique.ex: The chef showed us a new cooking technique.

that.en: introduces a clause or points to a thing

these.en: the ones here or just mentioned

threw.ex: The judge threw out the case for lack of evidence.

time.en: minutes, hours or days used for something
time.ex: I don't have time to cook tonight.

told.ex: She told her boss about the problem.

toxic.ex: Some plants are toxic to cats.

toxicity.en: how poisonous or harmful something is
toxicity.ex: Scientists tested the toxicity of the new pesticide.

example.en: Scientists tested the toxicity of the new chemical.
example.zh: 科學家測試了這種新化學物質的毒性。

note.usage: 不可數名詞；常見 low/high toxicity、the toxicity of + 物質。

noteEs.exampleTr: Los científicos analizaron la toxicidad del nuevo producto químico.
noteEs.meaning: toxicidad; grado en que algo es venenoso.
noteEs.usage: Se usa the toxicity of + sustancia.

noteHi.exampleTr: वैज्ञानिकों ने नए रसायन की विषाक्तता की जाँच की।
noteHi.usage: the toxicity of + पदार्थ आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 科学者たちは新しい化学物質の毒性を調べた。

paragraphs: Some ham, bacon and crisps get a smoky taste from smoke flavourings. The EU wants to stop these flavourings.
In 2024, the EU said they may not be safe. Food scientists had worries about health.
Kerry Group is a big food company from Tralee. It went to an EU court to fight the decision. This week, it lost the case.

Kerry once said up to 40% of ham and bacon in Ireland uses these flavourings. But the court said companies have time to find other ingredients. Meat, fish and cheese makers must stop using them by mid-2029.
Kerry says it is disappointed. It may appeal.
sentZh: 有些火腿、培根和洋芋片的煙燻味來自煙燻調味料。
歐盟想停止使用這些調味料。
2024年，歐盟表示它們可能不安全。
食品科學家對健康有疑慮。
凱瑞集團是一家來自特拉利的大型食品公司。
它到歐盟法院對這項決定提出抗爭。
這個星期，它輸了官司。
凱瑞曾說，愛爾蘭多達40%的火腿和培根使用這些調味料。
但法院說，公司有時間尋找其他原料。
肉品、魚類和起司製造商必須在2029年年中前停止使用它們。
凱瑞說它很失望。
它可能會上訴。

paragraphs: Smoke flavourings give a smoky taste to foods like ham, rashers and crisps. Now an EU court has rejected a case by the Irish company Kerry Group, so the EU can go ahead with its plan to phase them out.

In 2024, the European Commission decided not to renew the approval for several smoke flavourings because of health worries. A food safety review had found that concerns about toxic effects were either confirmed or could not be ruled out. EU countries supported the decision in a vote.

Kerry Group, which is based in Tralee, argued that these flavourings are healthier than traditional smoking, which is still allowed. It said producers might go back to the old method, which has greater health risks. It once told the Government that up to 40% of ham and bacon sold in Ireland used smoke flavourings.

The EU General Court did not agree. It said Kerry had not proved that producers would return to traditional smoking. It also said companies must show that a product is safe, and that they have several years to find other ingredients. Meat, fish and cheese producers must stop using the flavourings by mid-2029.
Kerry said it was disappointed and is studying the judgment. It may appeal.
sentZh: 煙燻調味料讓火腿、培根片和洋芋片等食物帶有煙燻味。
現在歐盟法院駁回了愛爾蘭公司凱瑞集團提出的訴訟，所以歐盟可以繼續推動逐步淘汰它們的計畫。
2024年，歐盟執委會因為健康疑慮，決定不再延長數種煙燻調味料的核准。
一項食品安全審查發現，對其毒性影響的擔憂不是已獲證實，就是無法排除。
歐盟各國在投票中支持這項決定。
總部位於特拉利的凱瑞集團主張，這些調味料比仍被允許的傳統煙燻法更健康。
它說生產者可能會回頭使用舊方法，而舊方法的健康風險更高。
它曾告訴政府，愛爾蘭販售的火腿和培根中，多達40%使用煙燻調味料。
歐盟普通法院不同意。
法院說，凱瑞並未證明生產者會改回傳統煙燻。
法院也說，公司必須證明產品安全，而且他們有好幾年時間可以找到其他原料。
肉品、魚類和起司生產者必須在2029年年中前停止使用這些調味料。
凱瑞說它很失望，正在研究這項判決。
它可能會上訴。

paragraphs: The EU General Court has dismissed a legal challenge by Kerry Group against the phasing out of several smoke flavourings used to give ham, rashers and crisps their smoky taste.

The European Commission decided in 2024 not to renew the authorisation of the flavourings, citing health concerns, after a food safety review concluded that worries about their toxicity were either confirmed or could not be ruled out. Member states backed the move in a vote.

The Tralee-based ingredients company argued that purified smoke flavourings are safer than traditional smoking, which remains legal, and warned that the ban could push producers back towards the older method. It had previously told the Government that up to 40% of ham and bacon sold in Ireland relied on the products.

The court rejected those arguments, finding that Kerry had not shown producers would revert to traditional smoking. It stressed that the burden lies with the applicant to demonstrate that a product poses no risk to human health, and said the transition period gave the industry time to find alternatives. Producers of meat, fish and cheese have until mid-2029 to phase the flavourings out.
Kerry said it was disappointed and would review the judgment, and it is understood to be considering an appeal.
sentZh: 歐盟普通法院駁回了凱瑞集團的法律挑戰，該公司反對逐步淘汰數種用來讓火腿、培根片和洋芋片帶有煙燻味的煙燻調味料。
一項食品安全審查認定，對這些調味料毒性的疑慮不是已獲證實、就是無法排除，歐盟執委會因此在2024年以健康疑慮為由，決定不再延長其授權。
會員國在投票中支持了這項措施。
這家總部位於特拉利的原料公司主張，純化煙燻調味料比仍屬合法的傳統煙燻更安全，並警告禁令可能會把生產者推回舊方法。
它先前曾告訴政府，愛爾蘭販售的火腿和培根中，多達40%依賴這些產品。
法院駁回了這些論點，認定凱瑞未能證明生產者會改回傳統煙燻。
法院強調，舉證責任在申請人身上，必須證明產品對人體健康不構成風險，並表示過渡期已給業界時間尋找替代品。
肉品、魚類和起司生產者必須在2029年年中前逐步停用這些調味料。
凱瑞表示感到失望，將會檢視這項判決，據了解正在考慮上訴。

paragraphs: Kerry Group has lost its bid to overturn the EU's phase-out of a number of smoke flavourings that lend ham, rashers and crisps their distinctive smoky tang, after the EU General Court threw out its challenge.

Brussels declined in 2024 to renew authorisation for the flavourings on health grounds, following a food safety assessment which found that fears over their toxicity were either borne out or could not be dismissed. Member states subsequently endorsed the decision.

The Tralee-based ingredients giant contended that purified smoke flavourings are a healthier option than conventional smoking, which remains permissible, and cautioned that the prohibition could drive producers back to the older, riskier technique. It had earlier alerted the Government that as much as 40% of the ham and bacon on Irish shelves hinged on these products.

The court was unpersuaded, ruling that Kerry had failed to substantiate its claim that manufacturers would revert to traditional smoking. It underscored that the onus rests on the applicant to prove a product is harmless and noted that the protracted transition period afforded the sector ample scope to source substitutes. Makers of meat, fish and cheese must dispense with the flavourings by mid-2029.
Kerry voiced its disappointment and said it would scrutinise the judgment; it is understood to be weighing an appeal.
sentZh: 歐盟普通法院駁回凱瑞集團的訴訟後，該公司推翻歐盟逐步淘汰數種煙燻調味料的努力宣告失敗；這些調味料賦予火腿、培根片和洋芋片獨特的煙燻風味。
一項食品安全評估發現，對其毒性的憂慮不是獲得證實、就是無法排除，布魯塞爾因此在2024年以健康為由，拒絕延長這些調味料的授權。
會員國隨後也認可了這項決定。
這家總部位於特拉利的原料巨頭主張，純化煙燻調味料比仍獲准使用的傳統煙燻更健康，並告誡禁令可能迫使生產者回頭採用較舊、風險較高的技術。
它早先曾提醒政府，愛爾蘭貨架上多達40%的火腿和培根都仰賴這些產品。
法院並未被說服，裁定凱瑞未能證實製造商會改回傳統煙燻的說法。
法院強調，證明產品無害的責任在申請人身上，並指出漫長的過渡期讓業界有充分空間尋找替代品。
肉品、魚類和起司製造商必須在2029年年中前停用這些調味料。
凱瑞表達失望，並表示將仔細審視這項判決；據了解該公司正在考慮上訴。

paragraphs: The EU General Court has rejected a legal challenge brought by Kerry Group against the gradual withdrawal of several smoke flavourings, which are widely used to give products such as ham, rashers and crisps a characteristic smoky flavour.

In 2024, the European Commission opted not to renew the authorisation of these substances on the grounds of public health, after a scientific evaluation concluded that concerns regarding their toxicity were either confirmed or could not be excluded. This decision was subsequently endorsed by member states.

The Tralee-based company maintained that purified smoke flavourings pose fewer health risks than traditional smoking, which remains lawful, and argued that the prohibition could consequently encourage producers to revert to the older method. It had previously informed the Government that a substantial proportion of ham and bacon sold in Ireland, potentially as much as 40%, was dependent on such flavourings.

Nevertheless, the court found that Kerry had not provided sufficient evidence to support this assertion. It emphasised that the burden of proof lies with the applicant to demonstrate that a product poses no risk to human health, and observed that the extended transition period would enable manufacturers to identify viable alternatives. Producers of meat, fish and cheese are required to discontinue their use by mid-2029.
Kerry expressed disappointment and indicated that it would examine the judgment carefully; it is reportedly considering whether to lodge an appeal.
sentZh: 歐盟普通法院駁回了凱瑞集團提出的法律挑戰；該公司反對逐步撤除數種煙燻調味料，這些調味料被廣泛用來讓火腿、培根片和洋芋片等產品帶有獨特的煙燻風味。
2024年，一項科學評估認定，對這些物質毒性的疑慮不是已獲證實、就是無法排除，歐盟執委會因此基於公共衛生理由，選擇不延長其授權。
這項決定隨後獲得會員國的支持。
這家總部位於特拉利的公司堅稱，純化煙燻調味料的健康風險低於仍屬合法的傳統煙燻，並主張禁令可能因此促使生產者改回舊方法。
它先前曾告知政府，愛爾蘭販售的火腿和培根中，有相當大的比例（可能高達40%）依賴這類調味料。
然而，法院認定凱瑞並未提出足夠證據來支持這項主張。
法院強調，舉證責任在申請人，須證明產品對人體健康不構成風險，並指出延長的過渡期能讓製造商找出可行的替代方案。
肉品、魚類和起司生產者必須在2029年年中前停止使用。
凱瑞表示失望，並指出將仔細檢視這項判決；據報導，該公司正在考慮是否提出上訴。
